<p dir="auto"><strong>ConstraintCommons.jl</strong> is an essential package within the <strong>Julia Constraints</strong> ecosystem designed to facilitate the development and interoperability of constraint programming solutions in Julia. It serves as a foundational layer that provides shared structures, abstract types, functions, and generic methods utilized by both basic feature packages and learning-oriented packages.</p>
